majors.target: piece-asphalt.png + all wasteland maps (settlement-1/4, ruined-city-2/5, shanty-3/6)
majors.issue: Asphalt reads as a water channel/canal, not a road: saturated navy-blue fill with short light horizontal dashes that read as ripples, no grey value, no lane paint, kerb or shoulder. Puddle props placed next to it reinforce the water read. Not family-compatible with ref-modern-city (grey asphalt, white markings).
majors.fix: Shift the ramp to desaturated warm or neutral grey (like modern-city asphalt, darker and dustier), replace the ripple dashes with cracks, potholes and faded lane-paint fragments, and add a crumbling kerb or gravel shoulder edge in the autotile mask.

majors.issue: The base dirt shows a visible lattice: dark oval blotches in regular staggered rows with a measured 64 px horizontal period (shanty-6 row band: |diff| 9.3 at 64 px vs about 21 at other offsets; settlement-4 15.0 vs about 22). Across the large empty ground it reads as polka-dot wallpaper.
majors.fix: Add more interior variants and break the blob layout so it doesn't follow a per-64px lattice (random variant per cell or larger non-periodic macro patches). Lower the blob contrast.

majors.issue: The shanty towns don't read as shanty towns. Huts, tents and stalls sit spaced out on an axis-aligned grid with 1-3 empty tiles around each, no alleys, lean-tos or clustering, and the open dirt between them is covered in a uniform confetti of debris and weed props. Settlement-4 uses the same scatter recipe and is nearly indistinguishable from shanty-6. Settlement-1 is the only one with a compound read. Shanty-3 and shanty-6 also share the same structure: a straight road across the top with an RV and a car on it, then rows of huts below.
majors.evidence: shanty-3.png and shanty-6.png overviews; /tmp/vqa-r4-B/sh3b.png (huts and tents in a straight row); settlement-4.png vs shanty-6.png side by side
majors.fix: Shanty: pack shelters into dense irregular clusters that share walls, with narrow winding alleys and tarp, fence and scrap infill between them; limit debris to near dwellings. Settlement: always build a walled or fenced compound (as in settlement-1) with a gate facing the road. Vary road topology per seed.

majors.issue: Identical stamps repeated side by side: two tent-tarps placed right next to each other with no variation (and tent-shack-tent sequences). The same shack-c also appears twice in a vertical column.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r4-B/sh3b.png top row (two identical tents between the shacks at map x~500-560,y~195); /tmp/vqa-r4-B/sh3a.png
majors.fix: Don't place the same piece in neighbouring slots; use flipped or colour variants, or mix in a different shelter type.

majors.issue: The yard quarter sits just below the village road but is separated from it by a sliver of grass less than one tile tall. It reads as a misaligned patch and not a quarter you can walk into from the road. Only mining-2 has a connecting spur.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r4-B/m7y.png top edge (path ends ~5px above yard), /tmp/vqa-r4-B/v3y.png top, /tmp/vqa-r4-B/t5y.png and t8y.png top (dirt path, then grass strip, then paving)
majors.fix: Either butt the yard directly against the road edge or always lay a path spur (as in mining-2) from the road into the yard entrance. Never leave a sub-tile grass sliver.

minors.issue: The temple, shrine and column pieces on the flagstone cast no ground shadow, while every Beodeul house does. The pale stone on pale paving is low-contrast and looks pasted on or floating. The main temple roof is drawn as an oblique parallelogram, which pushes toward a side or iso face.
minors.fix: Add the standard Beodeul drop shadow under ruin pieces and darken the flagstone grout slightly where they meet it.

minors.issue: Packed-dirt yard is a flat single-value brown with sparse pebbles. Large empty bands (e.g. vineyard-3 bottom third, mining-7 middle) look like an unfinished fill compared with the textured Beodeul ground.
minors.fix: Add a second value of tracks, wheel ruts or worn patches and shrink the yard to its contents.

minors.issue: Vine-row blocks are the same stamp repeated two or three times in the yard (the two right-hand blocks in vineyard-3 match pixel for pixel).
minors.fix: Vary the row count and length, or mirror the blocks.

minors.issue: A green square marker (spawn or debug overlay) is baked into the render at the left road edge.
minors.fix: Exclude editor overlays from review renders.

minors.issue: Road makes a hard rectangular jog with square notched corners and no turning shape.
minors.fix: Use the autotile's inner and outer corners, or smooth the jog over two tiles.

minors.issue: Right fence line has a repeating barrel/tyre/barrel/tyre column of the same stamps.
minors.fix: Thin out the props and randomise them.

minors.issue: Concrete slab lots are pasted onto the dirt with a hard straight cut and stepped notches (rows shifted by about one tile), with no broken edge transition. Weed and rubble props sit in the middle of the asphalt lanes.
minors.fix: Add a crumbled slab-edge autotile and keep road props near the kerbs.

minors.issue: The roof plane uses the same vertical corrugation and rust-blob density as the front wall, so the top and front read as one surface. The rust blobs are somewhat noisy.
minors.fix: Lighten the roof value one step and change the rib direction or treatment on the top.

piece_notes.tent-tarp: Transparent pinholes inside the opaque tent body at (10,19), (6,22), (5,23) and (29,25) let the ground show through. The shape is a pointed front-elevation teepee with the pole poking out of the apex, not a 3/4 ridge tent showing its roof plane.
piece_notes.asphalt: Navy hue with ripple dashes reads as water, no kerb or markings, and isn't family-compatible with modern-city.
